content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Janata Shikshan Sanstha, Kisan Veer Mahavidyalaya, Wai, dated 17 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Kisan Veer Mahavidyalaya, Wai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Kisan Veer Mahavidyalaya, Wai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 vacancies: 1 Clock Hour Basis Teacher (Sanskrit), 2 Clock Hour Basis Teacher (Geography), 1 Clock Hour Basis Teacher (Economics), 3 Clock Hour Basis Teacher (Accountancy), 8 Clock Hour Basis Teacher (Chemistry), 2 Clock Hour Basis Teacher (Zoology) and 1 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Kisan Veer Mahavidyalaya, Wai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kisan Veer Mahavidyalaya, Wai.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per government rules on Hourly Basis (CHB).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Not specified in the notice; the posts are filled under the Maharashtra Government Higher and Technical Education Department Government Resolutions dated 14.11.2018 and 17.10.2022, whose terms and conditions apply. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Appointed teacher must submit an undertaking on minimum stamp paper that he or she works in only one college at a time and in no other college.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview through the local selection committee. Selection through the local selection committee by walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary clock hour basis appointment for one academic year 2026-27 (maximum 09 months). Appointment ends automatically after the term. No right to regular service and no claim to permanency or any regular-service right.
